name: the collector releases a root of a live lease
a release keeps its index record, so a later slice releases the root again
a renewal brings back a lease the collector released
the collector ends a lease that still holds roots
a recovery holds again a root whose block lost its holders
a recovery moves only the roots in memory, not those indexed under the old lease
renewals run without the renew lock, so two renewers each start a lease and publish after their commits
replace:
Recover(w) ==
  /\ holder = NoRenewer
Recover(w) ==
  /\ TRUE
        /\ holder' = w
        /\ holder' = holder

name: without the renew lock the collector releases a root the process holds under its live lease
replace:
Recover(w) ==
  /\ holder = NoRenewer
Recover(w) ==
  /\ TRUE
        /\ holder' = w
        /\ holder' = holder
